0.14.0: ImgLink with your API key: Recent uploads now comes from your ImgLink account (including uploads made on the website), every one can be deleted, and the panel shows your storage and uploads left this hour.
0.13.2: ImgLink: its icon is now the top one of the upload icons, and the size limit follows your setup: 25 MB per image anonymously, 50 MB with your API key.
0.13.1: Settings: the ? tips stay inside the window and wrap their text. Upload keys are checked when saved: x02 and ImgLink show Verified or Not accepted in the field for a few seconds (Catbox has no way to check a userhash, so it shows Saved).
0.13.0: ImgLink (imglink.cc) as a third file host: its icon sits below Catbox in the left rail. Images up to 50 MB, always unlisted. Works anonymously or with your API key in Settings → Uploads, which also lets you delete uploads from the list.
0.12.5: iCloud, Yahoo and AOL: a login the mail server refuses only for a moment is tried again, and if it still fails shows as "couldn't refresh" instead of "signed out". Sign in is asked for only when the app password is actually rejected.
0.12.4: Uses the repository's new name (Unread-Mail_File-Hosting) for updates and the install command.
0.12.2: New name: Unread Mail & File Hosting.
0.12.1: Upload previews are small thumbnails kept on this computer, so they show instantly without downloading the full images again.
0.12.0: Double-click an account chip to open that mailbox on the web, or a provider's icon to open its default account. Drag the chips to reorder them; the first is the default (also ⋯ → Make default).
0.11.2: Uploads: click a preview or file name to open it in the app's viewer (images, PDFs, video, audio, Word, Excel, text), with ← / → through the list.
0.11.1: Uploads: when Catbox or x02 can't fetch a pasted link, "Download it here" downloads the file in the app and uploads it (Chrome asks once for access to websites).
0.11.0: Uploads: paste with ⌘V in the x02 or Catbox panel. A copied image uploads the original file (or the pasted picture if the site blocks it), a copied link uploads that file, and screenshots work too.
0.10.3: Uploads: Recent uploads keeps the last 100 per service (was 20); Catbox's Clear list button is gone.
0.10.2: Uploads: a wider panel with a fixed-width link column, and the copy, open and delete icons lined up in straight columns.
0.10.1: Uploads: the x02 and Catbox icons sit just above Recently read; Recent uploads shows previews, date and time, and a delete button (x02, and Catbox files uploaded with your userhash); the x02 list comes from your account, including files uploaded on the x02 website.
0.10.0: File uploads: the new x02 and Catbox icons in the left rail open a drop zone; each file gets a link that is shown, copied to the clipboard and kept in a list of recent uploads. The Catbox userhash and x02 API key go in Settings → Uploads.
0.9.4: Recently read, Sent, Drafts and Spam open instantly (no more "Loading…"): their lists are saved and kept fresh in the background, and refresh behind the scenes when opened.
0.9.3: Fixes the video/audio pause button sometimes needing several clicks.
0.9.2: Video and audio attachments play in the app, with controls that match it (speed, volume, full screen). Videos over 50 MB download when opened instead of in the background.
0.9.1: Tidier Settings: grouped sections, on/off switches, help behind ? icons, and the OAuth client IDs folded away.
0.9.0: Offline cache: every email in the app (unread, Recently read, Sent, Drafts, Spam), with its images and attachments, is downloaded in the background and opens instantly. Stored on this computer, 1 GB by default, changeable or cleared in Settings.
0.8.1: Fixes images in drafts saved by Gmail. Attachments: instant progress, faster iCloud/Yahoo/AOL downloads, arrows between attachments, password-protected Excel/Word, .xls, any text file, and a Download button instead of automatic downloads. From shows provider icons, Cc/Bcc can be hidden again, a close button for the open email, and dates read 30 Sep 2026 5:06PM.
0.8.0: Write email: compose, reply, reply all and forward from every account (Proton included), with drafts, inline images, attachments, address suggestions and undo send. Sent and Drafts at the bottom of the list. PDFs, Word and Excel attachments open in the app, with Print.
0.7.6: Emails open instantly the second time (last 30 are cached in memory, Proton included), and hovering an email loads it ahead of the click.
0.7.5: Recently read and Spam open in full (scrolling only if the window is too short) and show instantly from a cache while refreshing.
0.7.4: Recently read and Spam are pinned to the bottom of the list and open upwards.
0.7.3: Recently read and Spam also in each provider's All view (e.g. All Gmail), combined for its accounts.
0.7.2: The email provider's icon now sits next to the Open in … button.
0.7.1: Recently read and Spam also under All accounts, combined for every account. Spam now lists unread spam only.
0.7.0: Bulk delete with confirmation, a Spam section per account (unread count, Not spam, delete), and bigger icons in grouped notifications.
0.6.4: Clearer message when the helper is missing: it points to the one-line install command.
0.6.3: One-command installer; running it again also updates.
0.6.2: Removes the "Update test" label. Install update now also works when the extension folder was in Downloads.
0.6.1: Test release: shows a small "Update test" label next to the title.
0.6.0: Update banner: new versions are announced at the top of the app and install with one click.
